ATLAS_139fb_single_SSWW.description: Sec. 3.4, Sec. 9, Fig. 12 and concluding numerical summary. Single W±W±jj channel; not the later H+WZ plus H++WW combined search.
ATLAS_139fb_single_SSWW.branching_contract: The H5plane benchmark has BR(H++ -> WW)=1 in the interpretation used here. Identical scalar on-shell two-derivative tensor, matched W luminosities and response, common scaled binned signal and profile likelihood required.

representations: H++W-W- Feynman vertex i(2mW²/v) kappa times g_mn. GM kappa=sqrt(2) sin theta_H. Septet kappa=sqrt(15)y, y=4v7/v. Sum pp rates for the two electric signs using the original parton luminosities.
